tests.description: clean small fix with updated test — quiet review, ready verdict

- No API, persistence, RBAC, or UI screen behaviour changes.

tests.description: no-new-findings re-review — summary still posted, known inline comments not re-posted

- The new commit only rewords a comment block inside an agent skill file; the reviewer finds no new issues.
